Title - The Leaf Storm

Starring

* राहुल: 9 years, a boy
Look: green T-shirt, black shorts, red shoes
* वृंदा: 10 years, a girl
Look: round glasses, ponytail, yellow T-shirt

Sets

* the school ground: tall trees with yellow leaves, a heap of dry leaves, a low wall
* the bus stop: a tin shed, a bench, the road

Things

* ball: a red rubber ball
* rake: a long garden rake

Script starts

Scene 1: the school ground - Afternoon

[A strong wind blows. Red and yellow leaves fall from the trees and swirl across the ground.]

[राहुल throws the red ball high. It bounces off the wall and rolls away.]

राहुल (shouting): «Catch it, वृंदा!»

[वृंदा runs after the ball, her ponytail flying in the wind, and catches it.]

वृंदा (laughing): «Got it! Your throws are terrible, by the way.»

[राहुल rakes the dry leaves into a huge heap.]

Scene 2: the school ground - Evening

[राहुल runs and jumps into the leaf heap. Leaves fly everywhere.]

[Both lie on their backs in the leaves and look up at the falling leaves.]

वृंदा (softly): "Do you think the trees feel cold without their leaves?"

राहुल (thinking): "Maybe. That's why they need us to give them a hug."

[वृंदा turns her head towards राहुल and laughs.]

[A bus horn sounds. वृंदा looks over her shoulder.]

वृंदा (surprised): "Our bus! Run!"

[They grab their bags and run off towards the bus stop.]
